description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kudagammana, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510010
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of parcel numbers, extent, owners' names, identity card numbers, and land title classifications. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
